name: formatter-switch
about: A tooling history with one correction: the Python formatter moved from black to ruff. Probes share as few words as possible with their targets, so the vector arm has to do the work; the gate cases pit a genuine paraphrase and a same-shaped-but-different claim against the 0.95 threshold.

seeds.label: fmt-black
seeds.content: The project formats Python with black.

seeds.label: fmt-ruff
seeds.content: The project switched its Python formatter to ruff format; black is retired.

seeds.label: editor
seeds.content: The user edits in Helix, not VS Code.

seeds.label: test-runner
seeds.content: CI runs the test suite with pytest under tox.

seeds.label: lesson-cache
seeds.content: Cold cargo caches make the first CI build take twenty minutes; a nightly job keeps them warm.

seeds.label: distractor-lunch
seeds.content: The team orders Neapolitan pizza for Friday lunch.

seeds.label: distractor-plant
seeds.content: A fiddle-leaf fig sits by the office window and needs weekly watering.
